services.benefit: Build fast faceted search over product or document collections.
activation_steps: Confirm the official product, allowed purpose, current plan and relevant region.
Deploy Typesense, configure schemas and restricted search-only keys, and set up snapshots/backups.
Install a versioned release, bind privately, configure authentication/TLS, provision storage/models and verify a local health check.
Run one minimal, non-sensitive test after authorization; inspect status, usage units and any charge before broader use.
services.credential: Local administrator/API credentials that you configure; model/download tokens only when required by the source.
services.caveat: Do not expose administrative API keys through the client. Cluster reliability requires deliberate deployment design.

Install a versioned release, bind privately, configure authentication/TLS, provision storage/models and verify a local health check.
Run one minimal, non-sensitive test after authorization; inspect status, usage units and any charge before broader use.
